record.title: Compose the Linux native lifecycle delegate offline
record.intent: Preserve the exact reviewed native transaction under conventional Linux ownership.
requirements: Bind the separately reviewed Linux lease/phase boundary and original exact native deploy/remove source and pure validators. Adapt the tested foreground Linux owner callback and explicit remote completion framing, retaining raw partial command output, durable intent, no uncertain retries and exact introduction/removal lineage.

Prepare the original before/after APK/native/full corpus/epoch/ownership/map checks, fixed 16-byte O_RDONLY policy observations and corrected bounded reader lifecycle/reap proof. Retain original corpus exceptions only across transition; preserve one normal reboot, UID-first at most one authorized conditional root request and one distinct post-root readiness sequence, 60-second serviced settle and actual PNG/UI acceptance, exact 1801-second serviced warm-up and final gates.

Use a separate explicit native duration schema covering all gates, warm-up and cleanup, with original 4800/2400-second reserves and concrete Linux-domain deadline/lease checks. No future A1/B arm, postboot ACK, UI, corpus or introduced file may be invented. Freeze supplied-executor controls and runnable or template entrypoints with all unresolved physical integration limits stated.

Work entirely offline on preserved source and host-only controls. Do not start SSH, ADB, SCPI, DHCP, capture or serial against the bench, change namespace/network state, stage a reader, mutate native selection, request root/reboot or operate the specimen. Independent review must distinguish executable code and supplied controls from physically validated behavior.
acceptance: A reviewed native lifecycle composition or its exact unresolved offline integration boundary is durable.
